pull_request.title: style(list): use a dim outline flag for irregular worktrees
pull_request.body:
Display off-template paths and duplicate branch checkouts with a dim outline flag (`⚐`) instead of the dim yellow filled flag (`⚑`). Use the same neutral dim style as the other informational status symbols, and update help, documentation mirrors, and snapshots.

Validation: all 343 targeted list/help/promote tests pass, along with documentation sync, docs build, Clippy, and doctests. The full local gate has 5,012 passes and four failures: three background-removal timeouts (the tests pass in isolation on this branch and freshly rebuilt main) and a Git error-message snapshot mismatch reproduced on main with Git 2.56.0.

> _This was written by Codex on behalf of max-sixty_
